what_it_does: Extends the C++26 standard execution control library (senders and receivers abstraction for coordinating asynchronous parallel work) to support dynamic runtime systems. Traditional systems create work at compile time, but dynamic runtimes (like Qthreads, a user-level threading library) generate work at runtime with massive oversubscription (far more logical tasks than physical processors). This work demonstrates that C++26's execution control patterns work seamlessly with such dynamic systems, enabling better integration between standard C++ parallelism abstractions and specialized runtime systems.
